product_overview: Educar para Transformar is an educational institution web portal that combines a public landing page, family login and registration, and an authenticated administrative workspace. It also supports institutional reporting and catalog viewing for school operations.
core_goals: Learn about the institution, its educational levels, services, and enrollment options
Sign in to the institutional portal or create a family account
Browse and update institutional catalogs such as students, teachers, courses, subjects, sports, and transport routes
View, filter, refresh, and export institutional reports for academic and operational oversight

features.name: Public Landing and Contact
features.description: Visitors can explore the institutional website to learn about the school, review offerings and services, and submit enrollment inquiries.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the institution overview -> Explore the education levels and facilities -> Move through the site sections -> Submit an enrollment inquiry
Navigate to / -> Open the contact or enrollment section -> Review the available contact and enrollment information -> Submit an inquiry

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Families can sign in with institutional credentials or start a new family registration flow from the login portal.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter the institutional email address -> Enter the password -> Submit the login form -> Access the authenticated session
Navigate to /login -> Open the family registration form -> Enter the required family details -> Submit the registration form -> Create a new family account
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid login credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation or credential error messages

features.name: Administrative Entity Management
features.description: Authenticated staff can browse administrative catalogs for core institutional entities and refresh the displayed records.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Switch between the available management tabs -> Review student, teacher, course, subject, sports, or transport records -> Refine the table with search and filters -> Refresh the data view
Navigate to /admin -> Open a different catalog tab -> Review the corresponding records -> Update the displayed dataset

features.name: Administrative Reports Viewer
features.description: Authenticated staff can open institutional reports, filter their contents, switch between report types, and export or print the results.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Select a report type -> Review the generated institutional report -> Filter the data with a search query -> Export the report as CSV
Navigate to /admin -> Select a report type -> Review the generated institutional report -> Open the print or PDF preview -> Print or save the report
Navigate to /admin -> Select one report type -> Wait for the report to load -> Switch to another report type -> See the active report update without leaving the viewer
Navigate to /admin -> Select a report that requires a specific student or teacher -> Choose the corresponding record -> Review the personalized report data -> Refresh the report
